audit_mode: offline repository audit; no external NBA pages were fetched by this tool

policy.source_rule: Direct HTTPS links to NBA, regulator/statute, or statistical-authority hosts are counted as official sources. GitHub repo links are classified as repository evidence only.
policy.no_inference: Unmatched schedule rows remain unresolved; no missing matchup, time, value, or source is filled in.

findings.title: The checked-in Pages workflow contains unresolved merge-conflict markers.
findings.detail: The workflow source has literal conflict-marker lines. The staged-page list can still be counted, but this file is not a trustworthy release definition until the markers are removed and GitHub Actions validates the resulting YAML.

findings.title: The unified dashboard's citation check is page-wide, not table-row-wide.
findings.detail: `integrate/check.py` looks for an HTTPS link anywhere in a page body for each table; it does not collect links per row. The independent row parser found 869 staged table rows with no direct NBA, regulator/statute, or statistical-authority link and no explicit unverified marker.

findings.title: Some published table rows have no direct NBA or authority source link.
findings.detail: Across 117 Pages-staged HTML files, 2785 table-body rows were inspected. 994 rows have no direct NBA, regulator/statute, or statistical-authority link. Repository-code links are classified separately and do not count as NBA data citations.

findings.title: 3 published pick(s) exceed the exact 72-hour horizon.
findings.detail: POR @ MIN 2026-11-16 8:00 PM ET: 72.17h (+10 min); GSW @ NOP 2026-11-16 8:00 PM ET: 72.17h (+10 min); PHX @ DEN 2026-11-16 9:00 PM ET: 73.17h (+70 min). Keep only picks whose official tip time is within 72 hours of a timezone-aware generation timestamp, or explicitly define a different date-based policy.

findings.title: The canonical 'official capture' CI step is an offline hard-coded transcription check, not a live re-fetch.
findings.detail: The script contains static schedule, team-statistics, and injury-report constants and has no HTTP client import. Running it in CI checks the committed snapshot against those same constants; it cannot establish that a source is current or independently re-verify the transcription.

findings.title: The unified line artifact has no exact generation timestamp for a strict 72-hour check.
findings.detail: The artifact carries a date window and `horizon_days`, but no timezone-aware generation time. The exact tip-time horizon for its lines therefore cannot be reproduced from the artifact alone.

findings.title: The earlier source scanner treats GitHub repository links as 'official' links.
findings.detail: GitHub is primary evidence for repository facts and code, but it does not make a row's NBA statistics or injury values official. This audit keeps repository evidence in a separate class.
